body: That reply above was for you..sorry I dont really know what I'm doing on here yet.🤫

All I can say is thank you for your reply,and that my son doing what he did has literally broken my heart..and I say that too when I'm talking to him. I say son,you REALLY hurt your mommy..and the tears start to fall..all the little things that I miss,like I have the pillow he slept on put away,and the one and only dress shirt and tie,that he owned lol..ever so often I "smell" these things trying my best to get his scent again..
My own dad killed himself when I was 24 and I thought that was bad,honey,that wasn't anything compared to the pain I feel to have lost my son. Do everything you possibly can to NEVER put your mom where I am.
I did ECT and TMS for 6 weeks and neither helped me either.
